dataset_status: starter roadmap data; not a list of external or accredited courses
important_note: Modules are internal prototype learning activities. They do not represent official courses, accreditation, certification, or training-provider availability. Member 4 should review educational quality and local relevance.

courses.title: Safety and Electrical Awareness
courses.description: Foundation concepts for identifying common electrical hazards and understanding why supervised practice matters.
courses.practical_task: Create a labelled list of common electrical hazards in a fictional workshop scene.
courses.completion_criteria: Identify at least five hazards and describe a safe response for each.
courses.source_status: prototype-authored learning activity; not an accredited course

courses.title: Basic Circuits and Measurement
courses.description: Introduction to circuit concepts, simple diagrams, units, and measurement terminology.
courses.practical_task: Label a low-risk paper circuit diagram and match symbols to their meanings.
courses.completion_criteria: Correctly explain the purpose of the main symbols in the practice diagram.
courses.source_status: prototype-authored learning activity; not an accredited course

courses.title: Solar PV System Basics
courses.description: Introduction to solar energy components and the roles they play in a basic system.
courses.practical_task: Draw a simple block diagram of a solar PV system and label its main components.
courses.completion_criteria: Submit a labelled diagram and explain each component in plain language.
courses.source_status: prototype-authored learning activity; not an accredited course

courses.title: Electronic Components
courses.description: Recognise common electronic components and describe their basic purpose.
courses.practical_task: Match component names with simple pictures or symbols.
courses.completion_criteria: Identify the components in the provided practice sheet.
courses.source_status: prototype-authored learning activity; not an accredited course

courses.title: Circuit and Measurement Basics
courses.description: Learn safe, introductory circuit reading and measurement vocabulary.
courses.practical_task: Annotate a simple circuit diagram and write down the units used for basic measurements.
courses.completion_criteria: Complete the diagram labels and measurement questions accurately.
courses.source_status: prototype-authored learning activity; not an accredited course

courses.title: Structured Troubleshooting
courses.description: Use a simple observe-check-record process to reason about a fictional device fault.
courses.practical_task: Work through a paper-based fault scenario and record possible causes before choosing a check.
courses.completion_criteria: Record observations, possible causes, and a justified next check.
courses.source_status: prototype-authored learning activity; not an accredited course

courses.title: Electrical Safety Foundations
courses.description: Learn hazard recognition, safe boundaries, and when to call a qualified person.
courses.practical_task: Review a fictional home-safety scenario and mark hazards without touching equipment.
courses.completion_criteria: Identify hazards and state when qualified help is required.
courses.source_status: prototype-authored learning activity; not an accredited course

courses.title: Basic Circuits and Diagrams
courses.description: Learn simple circuit ideas, diagram symbols, and measurement vocabulary.
courses.practical_task: Label a simple paper circuit diagram.
courses.completion_criteria: Correctly label the main components and explain the circuit path.
courses.source_status: prototype-authored learning activity; not an accredited course

courses.title: Tools and Measurement Awareness

courses.practical_task: Complete a tool-identification and safe-use worksheet; do not perform live electrical work.
courses.completion_criteria: Match tools to their general purposes and list essential precautions.

courses.title: Respectful Care and Communication

courses.title: Charts and Explaining Findings
